findings.title: The unit tests step can no longer fail: without `shell:` the pipe takes tee's exit status
findings.why_it_matters: A step with no `shell:` runs as `bash -e {0}` on GitHub-hosted Linux, without pipefail, so the job sees tee's status (0) and a failing test suite goes green. The lint step above is fine because `shell: bash` adds `-o pipefail`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `shell: bash` to the unit tests step, as the lint step does.
